decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by using various counterspells, tutors, and card draw spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes powerful win conditions like Bolas's Citadel, Time Vault combo, and powerful creatures like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes powerful artifact mana acceleration like the Moxen and Sol Ring to ramp out threats quickly. Overall, the key strategy is to control the game's pace and outvalue the opponent with efficient card advantage and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on using the graveyard and various spells to combo off and win the game quickly. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth's Will, Doomsday, and Thassa's Oracle to set up a winning sequence of plays. The deck also includes a suite of powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect the combo. By carefully managing resources and timing plays, the pilot can assemble the necessary pieces to execute their game-winning combo and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively filling the graveyard with creatures to quickly bring back powerful threats like Hogaak and Vengevine. It also uses cards like Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck has a low mana curve and aims to establish board presence early while also having tools to disrupt opponents' game plans. The inclusion of cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier help consistently fill the graveyard, allowing the deck to maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to generate mana and draw cards, while also utilizing the combo of Scrap Trawler, Ichor Wellspring, and Krark-Clan Ironworks to create a loop that generates infinite mana and draws the entire deck. This combo can be further enhanced by cards like Mystic Forge and Tinker to find and assemble the pieces quickly. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for additional utility and disruption, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion that can provide additional mana acceleration. The overall strategy is to quickly assemble the combo and win the game in a single turn.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game by using powerful control spells and efficient card advantage engines. By using cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Tinker to find and protect key combo pieces like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions. Various tutor effects and mana acceleration also help ensure the deck can find and play its most impactful cards quickly and efficiently. Additionally, Narset, Parter of Veils and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade provide additional disruption against certain strategies, while cards like Monastery Mentor and Sphinx of the Steel Wind offer powerful threats to close out the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be quickly cast from the graveyard or hand, with the help of cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier. It aims to overwhelm opponents with fast creatures like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Force of Vigor. The deck also includes powerful one-drop creatures like Deathrite Shaman and Grief, along with mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and the Moxen. The combination of quick mana, graveyard recursion, and aggressive creatures makes this deck a threat in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with dredge cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for explosive graveyard-based combos with cards like Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Silversmote Ghoul. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Force of Vigor to protect the combo pieces and deal with opposing threats. Bazaar of Baghdad is used to quickly filter through the deck and fuel the graveyard, maximizing the deck's potential for explosive plays.

The focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through card advantage, disruption, and powerful win conditions. It utilizes a combination of counterspells, card draw, tutors, and powerful artifacts like Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault to dominate the board. The deck also includes key components such as mana acceleration from Moxen, tutoring for essential cards, and versatile removal options. The win conditions include powerful creatures like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Monastery Mentor. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up a strong board presence to ultimately secure victory.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive artifacts, all while utilizing powerful mana acceleration from cards like Mishra's Workshop and the Moxen. The deck also utilizes powerful land destruction like Ghost Quarter and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Crucible of Worlds help provide additional value and flexibility in the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck's strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game through disruptive artifacts and land destruction.

The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and disruptive Aggro strategy, utilizing powerful artifacts and mana acceleration from cards like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb. The deck's creatures, such as Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, can quickly grow in power and dominate the battlefield. In addition, cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Phyrexian Revoker can shut down the opponent's key cards and strategies. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere to slow down the opponent's game plan, allowing the Aggro strategy to take over the game.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize powerful creatures like Hollow One, Vengevine, and Master of Death along with Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard to bring back creatures and maintain card advantage. Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Force of Vigor provide protection and disruption to control the game while cards like Serum Powder help with consistency and setup. Strip Mine and Wasteland are included for additional disruption while Noxious Revival and Chalice of the Void offer versatility and control options.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly put powerful Goblins into play, along with disruptive cards like Magus of the Moon and Thorn of Amethyst to disrupt the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to quickly establish board control and pressure the opponent. With powerful finishers like Muxus, Goblin Grandee and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker, this deck is capable of explosive and game-ending plays to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and limiting opponent's resources. It utilizes powerful spells like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Mindbreak Trap to counter threats, while also using cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor to disrupt opponent's artifacts. The deck also incorporates card advantage with Wrenn and Six, Ancestral Recall, and Treasure Cruise. The key strategy is to generate value over time with control elements like Standstill and efficient removal spells, while utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion for additional recursion.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana and assemble powerful artifact-based combos to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Tinker, Urza, Lord High Artificer, and Bolas's Citadel, the deck aims to create explosive plays that can quickly win the game. With a strong artifact and blue spell package, the deck can also control the game with counterspells and draw spells, ensuring its dominance in the match. The key strategy is to efficiently use the artifacts and blue cards to create a winning board state while outmaneuvering the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively fill up the graveyard with cards like Basking Rootwalla, Bloodghast, and Vengevine, while utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to dig for key pieces. By leveraging the graveyard, cards like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Hollow One can be easily cast for cheap or even for free. The deck also has disruptive elements like Force of Vigor and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it a fast-paced and powerful aggro deck that aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling a hand that can win the game in a single turn through the use of the Doomsday combo, which involves stacking the top 5 cards of your library in a specific order to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The key concept revolves around using a combination of draw spells, cantrips, and counterspells to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for the combo while protecting your game plan from disruption. It leverages powerful cards like Force of Will and Demonic Tutor to efficiently and effectively execute the combo.
